The env-name checks accept both names, even though the shell would treat the quoted text as one principal value and would not assign `CRQ_QUEUE_POLICY`. This is a validation/parsing defect in the existing authorized-keys command check; reject quote characters or use shell-aware tokenization before accepting the command.
